m.e: Thinking about turning it, like, into an opera or something. I don't know.

m.e: She's not gonna kill you. Not when I'm like this, maybe, but later, when I turn.

m.t: Přineste své vzácné kovy a já to změním.
m.e: Go and fetch your precious metals, and I'll change that.

m.e: That, or you keep chasing me, and I change history a hundred more times.

m.e: If you think doing this is going to turn me into you, you don't understand people at all.

m.e: You know, Louis, I am gonna change the world, but sometimes you need a few small victories just to keep you going.

m.e: Then maybe I'll change my mind.

m.t: - Já myslela, že změním tvůj názor!
m.e: I thought that I was changing your mind!

m.t: Když změním jen Jen jedna věc v této místnosti.
m.e: If I change just just one thing in this room.

m.e: I'm gonna let her order for me, too, but then I'm just gonna turn it into whatever I want.

m.t: Jestli to zákon nedovoluje, změním ho.
m.e: If the law will not permit it, I will change the law.

m.t: Pak jeho názor změním.
m.e: Then I'll change him.

m.t: Ne když se změním.
m.e: Not when I change.

m.t: Jak dnes změním svět?
m.e: How am I going to change the world today?

m.t: Dnes to všechno změním.
m.e: Tonight, I change all that.

m.e: - Okay, I better change.

m.e: Perhaps I can change it for her.
